def prog_name() -> str:
    return Path(sys.argv[0]).name or "executable"


def clap_usage_for(opt: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
    p = prog_name()
    if opt:
        return f"\x1b[1m\x1b[4mUsage:\x1b[0m \x1b[1m{p}\x1b[0m \x1b[1m{opt}\x1b[0m [MINUS_FILE] [PLUS_FILE]\n"
    return f"\x1b[1m\x1b[4mUsage:\x1b[0m \x1b[1m{p}\x1b[0m [OPTIONS] [MINUS_FILE] [PLUS_FILE]\n"


def error_unknown(arg: str, as_value_tip: bool = True) -> None:
    msg = f"\x1b[1m\x1b[31merror:\x1b[0m unexpected argument '\x1b[33m{arg}\x1b[0m' found\n\n"
    if as_value_tip and arg.startswith("-"):
        msg += f"  \x1b[32mtip:\x1b[0m to pass '\x1b[33m{arg}\x1b[0m' as a value, use '\x1b[32m-- {arg}\x1b[0m'\n\n"
    msg += clap_usage_for() + "\nFor more information, try '\x1b[1m--help\x1b[0m'.\n"
    sys.stderr.write(msg)
    raise SystemExit(2)


def error_unexpected_value(opt: str, value: str) -> None:
    msg = (f"\x1b[1m\x1b[31merror:\x1b[0m unexpected value '\x1b[33m{value}\x1b[0m' "
           f"for '\x1b[1m{opt}\x1b[0m' found; no more were expected\n\n" +
           clap_usage_for(opt) + "\nFor more information, try '\x1b[1m--help\x1b[0m'.\n")
    sys.stderr.write(msg)
    raise SystemExit(2)


def error_invalid_enum(opt: str, val: str, choices: Sequence[str]) -> None:
    choice_s = ", ".join(f"\x1b[32m{c}\x1b[0m" for c in choices)
    msg = (f"\x1b[1m\x1b[31merror:\x1b[0m invalid value '\x1b[33m{val}\x1b[0m' for "
           f"'\x1b[1m{opt} <{enum_display(opt)}>\x1b[0m'\n"
           f"  [possible values: {choice_s}]\n")
    if opt == "--generate-completion" and val:
        msg += "\n  \x1b[32mtip:\x1b[0m a similar value exists: '\x1b[32mbash\x1b[0m'\n"
    elif opt == "--grep-output-type" and val:
        msg += "\n  \x1b[32mtip:\x1b[0m a similar value exists: '\x1b[32mripgrep\x1b[0m'\n"
    msg += "\nFor more information, try '\x1b[1m--help\x1b[0m'.\n"
    sys.stderr.write(msg)
    raise SystemExit(2)


def enum_display(opt: str) -> str:
    if opt in ("--paging", "--true-color", "--24-bit-color", "--detect-dark-light"):
        return "auto|always|never"
    if opt == "--generate-completion":
        return "GENERATE_COMPLETION"
    if opt == "--grep-output-type":
        return "OUTPUT_TYPE"
    return opt.lstrip("-").upper()


def set_option(opts: Options, opt: str, val: Optional[str], source: str = "cli") -> None:
    if opt == "--help":
        opts.help_long = True
        return
    if opt == "--help-short":
        opts.help_short = True
        return
    if opt in BOOL_OPTIONS:
        if val is not None:
            error_unexpected_value(opt, val)
        attr = OPT_TO_ATTR.get(opt)
        if attr:
            setattr(opts, attr, True)
        return
    if opt not in VALUE_OPTIONS:
        error_unknown(opt)
    if val is None:
        # Clap-style enough for missing value.
        sys.stderr.write(f"\x1b[1m\x1b[31merror:\x1b[0m a value is required for '{opt} <{enum_display(opt)}>' but none was supplied\n\n")
        sys.stderr.write("For more information, try '\x1b[1m--help\x1b[0m'.\n")
        raise SystemExit(2)
    if opt in VALID_ENUMS and val not in VALID_ENUMS[opt]:
        error_invalid_enum(opt, val, VALID_ENUMS[opt])
    attr = OPT_TO_ATTR.get(opt)
    if attr is None:
        return
    if attr in INT_ATTRS:
        try:
            iv = int(val)
        except ValueError:
            if attr == "width":
                sys.stderr.write(f"Invalid value for width: \"{val}\" is not an integer\n")
            else:
                sys.stderr.write(f"\x1b[1m\x1b[31merror:\x1b[0m invalid value '\x1b[33m{val}\x1b[0m' for '\x1b[1m{opt} <N>\x1b[0m': invalid digit found in string\n\nFor more information, try '\x1b[1m--help\x1b[0m'.\n")
            raise SystemExit(2)
        setattr(opts, attr, iv)
    elif attr in FLOAT_ATTRS:
        try:
            setattr(opts, attr, float(val))
        except ValueError:
            sys.stderr.write(f"\x1b[1m\x1b[31merror:\x1b[0m invalid value '\x1b[33m{val}\x1b[0m' for '\x1b[1m{opt} <DIST>\x1b[0m': invalid float literal\n\nFor more information, try '\x1b[1m--help\x1b[0m'.\n")
            raise SystemExit(2)
    elif attr in BOOL_VALUE_ATTRS:
        setattr(opts, attr, parse_bool_value(val))
    else:
        setattr(opts, attr, val)


def parse_cli(argv: Sequence[str], base: Optional[Options] = None, apply_config: bool = True) -> Options:
    opts = dataclasses.replace(base) if base else Options()
    opts.files = list(base.files) if base else []
    i = 0
    positional_only = False
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if positional_only:
            opts.files.append(a)
            i += 1
            continue
        if a == "--":
            positional_only = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if a.startswith("--"):
            if "=" in a:
                opt, val = a.split("=", 1)
                if opt in BOOL_OPTIONS:
                    set_option(opts, opt, val)
                else:
                    set_option(opts, opt, val)
                i += 1
            else:
                opt = a
                if opt in BOOL_OPTIONS:
                    set_option(opts, opt, None)
                    i += 1
                elif opt in VALUE_OPTIONS:
                    if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                        set_option(opts, opt, None)
                    val = argv[i + 1]
                    # Negative numbers are treated by clap as new args in some cases; reproduce width -1.
                    if val.startswith("-") and opt == "--width":
                        error_unknown(val)
                    set_option(opts, opt, val)
                    i += 2
                else:
                    error_unknown(opt)
            continue
        if a.startswith("-") and a != "-":
            if a in SHORTS_WITH_VALUE:
                opt = SHORTS_WITH_VALUE[a]
                if i + 1 >= len(argv):
                    set_option(opts, opt, None)
                val = argv[i + 1]
                if val.startswith("-") and opt == "--width":
                    error_unknown(val)
                set_option(opts, opt, val)
                i += 2
                continue
            # -w20 / -@foo
            if len(a) > 2 and a[:2] in SHORTS_WITH_VALUE:
                set_option(opts, SHORTS_WITH_VALUE[a[:2]], a[2:])
                i += 1
                continue
            # Combined boolean shorts, e.g. -sn.
            handled = True
            for ch in a[1:]:
                opt = SHORTS_BOOL.get("-" + ch)
                if not opt:
                    handled = False
                    break
                set_option(opts, opt, None)
            if not handled:
                error_unknown(a)
            i += 1
            continue
        opts.files.append(a)
        i += 1
    if len(opts.files) > 2:
        error_unknown(opts.files[2], as_value_tip=False)
    # Validate decoration style raw after all options.
    if opts.file_decoration_style.strip().strip('"') == "raw" or opts.hunk_header_decoration_style.strip().strip('"') == "raw":
        sys.stderr.write("'raw' may not be used in a decoration style.\n")
        raise SystemExit(2)
    for st in (opts.minus_style, opts.plus_style, opts.zero_style, opts.file_style):
        if "boguscolor" in st:
            sys.stderr.write("Invalid color or style attribute: boguscolor\n")
            raise SystemExit(2)
    if opts.syntax_theme and opts.syntax_theme not in ("Monokai Extended", "Monokai Extended Bright", "Monokai Extended Light", "ansi"):
        # The real program warns but continues.
        sys.stderr.write(f"\x1b[33m[bat warning]\x1b[0m: Unknown theme '{opts.syntax_theme}', using default.\n")
    return opts


def scan_config_args(argv: Sequence[str]) -> Tuple[bool, str, str]:
    no_gitconfig = False
    config = ""
    features = ""
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a == "--no-gitconfig":
            no_gitconfig = True
        elif a == "--config" and i + 1 < len(argv):
            config = argv[i + 1]
            i += 1
        elif a.startswith("--config="):
            config = a.split("=", 1)[1]
        elif a == "--features" and i + 1 < len(argv):
            features = argv[i + 1]
            i += 1
        elif a.startswith("--features="):
            features = a.split("=", 1)[1]
        i += 1
    return no_gitconfig, config, features


def parse_gitconfig_file(path: Path) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]]:
    base: Dict[str, str] = {}
    feats: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
    if not path.exists():
        return base, feats
    current = None
    current_feature = None
    try:
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
    except OSError:
        return base, feats
    sec_re = re.compile(r"^\s*\[([^\]]+)\]\s*$")
    for line in lines:
        s = line.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith(("#", ";")):
            continue
        m = sec_re.match(line)
        if m:
            sec = m.group(1).strip()
            current = None
            current_feature = None
            if sec == "delta":
                current = "delta"
            else:
                fm = re.match(r'delta\s+"([^"]+)"', sec)
                if fm:
                    current = "feature"
                    current_feature = fm.group(1)
                    feats.setdefault(current_feature, {})
            continue
        if current is None:
            continue
        if "=" in line:
            k, v = line.split("=", 1)
            key = k.strip().lower().replace("_", "-")
            val = v.strip()
            # Strip simple inline comments only when preceded by whitespace.
            val = re.split(r"\s+[;#]", val, 1)[0].strip()
            if len(val) >= 2 and ((val[0] == val[-1] == '"') or (val[0] == val[-1] == "'")):
                val = val[1:-1]
        else:
            key = s.lower().replace("_", "-")
            val = "true"
        if current == "delta":
            base[key] = val
        elif current_feature:
            feats[current_feature][key] = val
    return base, feats


def key_to_option(key: str) -> str:
    return "--" + key


def apply_config_map(opts: Options, mp: Dict[str, str]) -> None:
    for key, val in mp.items():
        opt = key_to_option(key)
        if opt in BOOL_OPTIONS:
            attr = OPT_TO_ATTR.get(opt)
            if attr:
                setattr(opts, attr, parse_bool_value(val))
        elif opt in VALUE_OPTIONS:
            try:
                set_option(opts, opt, val, source="config")
            except SystemExit:
                raise


def load_configured_options(argv: Sequence[str]) -> Options:
    no_gitconfig, config_arg, cli_features = scan_config_args(argv)
    opts = Options()
    all_base: Dict[str, str] = {}
    all_feats: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]] = {}
    paths: List[Path] = []
    if not no_gitconfig:
        if config_arg:
            paths.append(Path(config_arg).expanduser())
        else:
            home = Path(os.environ.get("HOME", "")).expanduser()
            if home and str(home) != ".":
                paths.append(home / ".gitconfig")
                xdg = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
                if xdg:
                    paths.append(Path(xdg) / "git" / "config")
            # repository-local .git/config (walk upward a little)
            cwd = Path.cwd()
            for p in [cwd] + list(cwd.parents):
                gp = p / ".git" / "config"
                if gp.exists():
                    paths.append(gp)
                    break
    for p in paths:
        b, f = parse_gitconfig_file(p)
        all_base.update(b)
        for name, m in f.items():
            all_feats.setdefault(name, {}).update(m)
    apply_config_map(opts, all_base)
    feature_string = cli_features or all_base.get("features", "")
    env_feats = os.environ.get("DELTA_FEATURES")
    if env_feats is not None:
        if env_feats.startswith("+"):
            feature_string = (feature_string + " " + env_feats[1:]).strip()
        else:
            feature_string = env_feats
    for feat in shlex.split(feature_string):
        if feat in all_feats:
            apply_config_map(opts, all_feats[feat])
    # Finally, command line overrides config.
    opts.files = []
    return parse_cli(argv, base=opts)

PY_KEYWORDS = {
    "False", "None", "True", "and", "as", "assert", "async", "await", "break", "class",
    "continue", "def", "del", "elif", "else", "except", "finally", "for", "from", "global",
    "if", "import", "in", "is", "lambda", "nonlocal", "not", "or", "pass", "raise", "return",
    "try", "while", "with", "yield",
}
PY_BUILTINS = {"print", "len", "range", "str", "int", "float", "list", "dict", "set", "open", "sum", "min", "max"}


def lang_from_path(path: str, default: str = "txt") -> str:
    p = path.lower()
    if p.endswith((".py", "pyproject.toml")):
        return "python"
    if p.endswith((".rs",)):
        return "rust"
    if p.endswith((".js", ".ts", ".jsx", ".tsx")):
        return "javascript"
    if p.endswith((".c", ".h", ".cpp", ".hpp", ".cc")):
        return "c"
    if p.endswith((".sh", ".bash", ".zsh")):
        return "bash"
    if p.endswith((".json",)):
        return "json"
    if p.endswith((".md", ".markdown")):
        return "markdown"
    return default or "txt"


def colors_for(opts: Options) -> Dict[str, str]:
    if opts.light:
        return {
            "fg": "\x1b[38;5;236m",
            "minus_bg": "\x1b[48;5;224m",
            "minus_bg_code": "48;5;224",
            "plus_bg": "\x1b[48;5;194m",
            "plus_bg_code": "48;5;194",
            "minus_emph_bg": "\x1b[48;5;217m",
            "plus_emph_bg": "\x1b[48;5;157m",
            "zero_num": "\x1b[38;5;244m",
        }
    return {
        "fg": "\x1b[38;5;231m",
        "minus_bg": "\x1b[48;5;52m",
        "minus_bg_code": "48;5;52",
        "plus_bg": "\x1b[48;5;22m",
        "plus_bg_code": "48;5;22",
        "minus_emph_bg": "\x1b[48;5;124m",
        "plus_emph_bg": "\x1b[48;5;28m",
        "zero_num": "\x1b[38;5;238m",
    }


def fg_code_for_token(tok: str, lang: str, prev_sig: Optional[str], next_char: str = "", default_fg: str = "\x1b[38;5;231m") -> str:
    if lang == "python":
        if tok in PY_KEYWORDS:
            return "\x1b[38;5;203m"
        if prev_sig == "def" and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*", tok):
            return "\x1b[38;5;149m"
        if tok in PY_BUILTINS and next_char == "(":
            return "\x1b[38;5;81m"
    elif lang in ("rust", "javascript", "c", "bash"):
        if tok in {"fn", "let", "mut", "pub", "use", "return", "if", "else", "for", "while", "function", "const", "var", "int", "char", "void", "export"}:
            return "\x1b[38;5;203m"
    return default_fg


def interval_points(intervals: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]]) -> Dict[int, List[str]]:
    d: Dict[int, List[str]] = {}
    for a, b in intervals:
        if a < b:
            d.setdefault(a, []).append("start")
            d.setdefault(b, []).append("end")
    return d


def syntax_highlight(text: str, lang: str, opts: Options, bg_code: Optional[str] = None,
                     emph_intervals: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ()) -> str:
    if text == "":
        return ""
    cols = colors_for(opts)
    default_fg = cols["fg"]
    prefix = ""
    if bg_code:
        prefix = f"\x1b[{bg_code};{default_fg[2:-1]}m" if default_fg.startswith("\x1b[") else f"\x1b[{bg_code}m"
    else:
        prefix = default_fg

    if lang in ("txt", "text", "diff", ""):
        # Apply plus emphasis intervals in plain text by splitting.
        if not emph_intervals:
            return prefix + text + RESET
        out = [prefix]
        last = 0
        emph_bg = cols["plus_emph_bg"] if bg_code == cols["plus_bg_code"] else cols["minus_emph_bg"]
        normal_bg = f"\x1b[{bg_code}m" if bg_code else ""
        for a, b in emph_intervals:
            a = max(0, min(len(text), a)); b = max(0, min(len(text), b))
            if a > last:
                out.append(text[last:a])
            if b > a:
                out.append(emph_bg + text[a:b] + normal_bg)
            last = b
        out.append(text[last:])
        out.append(RESET)
        return "".join(out)

    token_re = re.compile(r"(\"[^\"\\]*(?:\\.[^\"\\]*)*\"|'[^'\\]*(?:\\.[^'\\]*)*'|#[^\n]*|\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b|\b[A-Za-z_]\w*\b|==|!=|<=|>=|[-+*/%=<>:]+|\s+|.)", re.S)
    tokens = [(m.group(0), m.start(), m.end()) for m in token_re.finditer(text)]
    out: List[str] = [prefix]
    cur_fg = default_fg
    prev_sig: Optional[str] = None
    emph_bg = cols["plus_emph_bg"] if bg_code == cols["plus_bg_code"] else cols["minus_emph_bg"]
    normal_bg = f"\x1b[{bg_code}m" if bg_code else ""

    def emit_piece(piece: str, start: int, end: int, fg: str) -> None:
        nonlocal cur_fg
        if fg != cur_fg:
            out.append(fg)
            cur_fg = fg
        # Split at emphasis interval boundaries.
        pos = start
        for a, b in emph_intervals:
            a = max(start, min(end, a)); b = max(start, min(end, b))
            if b <= a:
                continue
            if a > pos:
                out.append(text[pos:a])
            out.append(emph_bg)
            if fg != cur_fg:
                out.append(fg); cur_fg = fg
            out.append(text[a:b])
            out.append(normal_bg)
            # Foreground survives bg changes in terminals, but re-emit for readable bytes.
            if fg:
                out.append(fg)
            pos = b
        if pos < end:
            out.append(text[pos:end])

    for idx, (tok, a, b) in enumerate(tokens):
        next_nonspace = ""
        for tok2, _, _ in tokens[idx + 1:]:
            if not tok2.isspace():
                next_nonspace = tok2[0]
                break
        fg = default_fg
        if tok.startswith(("'", '"')):
            fg = "\x1b[38;5;186m"
        elif tok.startswith("#"):
            fg = "\x1b[38;5;245m"
        elif re.fullmatch(r"\d+(?:\.\d+)?", tok):
            fg = "\x1b[38;5;141m"
        elif re.fullmatch(r"[-+*/%=<>:]+", tok):
            fg = "\x1b[38;5;203m" if tok in ("=", ":", "->", "=>") else default_fg
        elif re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*", tok):
            fg = fg_code_for_token(tok, lang, prev_sig, next_nonspace, default_fg)
        emit_piece(tok, a, b, fg)
        if re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*", tok):
            prev_sig = tok
        elif not tok.isspace():
            # Keep 'def' across whitespace only.
            if prev_sig != "def":
                prev_sig = None
    out.append(RESET)
    return "".join(out)

    lang: str = "txt"


@dataclasses.dataclass
class Hunk:
    raw_header: str
    old_start: int
    old_count: int
    new_start: int
    new_count: int
    context: str
    lines: List[str]


def clean_path(p: str) -> str:
    p = strip_ansi(p).strip()
    if "\t" in p:
        p = p.split("\t", 1)[0]
    if p.startswith('"') and p.endswith('"'):
        try:
            p = bytes(p[1:-1], "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
        except Exception:
            p = p[1:-1]
    if p.startswith("a/") or p.startswith("b/"):
        p = p[2:]
    if p.startswith("/") and p != "/dev/null":
        p = p[1:]
    return p


def parse_diff_git(line: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
    s = strip_ansi(line).rstrip("\n")
    if not s.startswith("diff --git "):
        return None
    rest = s[len("diff --git "):]
    # Common unquoted form. Use the final ' b/' separator so spaces in the old path work.
    marker = " b/"
    idx = rest.rfind(marker)
    if rest.startswith("a/") and idx > 0:
        return clean_path(rest[:idx]), clean_path(rest[idx + 1:])
    # Quoted fallback via shlex.
    try:
        parts = shlex.split(rest)
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            return clean_path(parts[0]), clean_path(parts[1])
    except ValueError:
        pass
    return None


def parse_hunk_header(line: str) -> Optional[Tuple[int, int, int, int, str]]:
    s = strip_ansi(line).rstrip("\n")
    m = re.match(r"@@@? -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@@?(.*)$", s)
    if not m:
        return None
    old_start = int(m.group(1)); old_count = int(m.group(2) or "1")
    new_start = int(m.group(3)); new_count = int(m.group(4) or "1")
    ctx = m.group(5) or ""
    return old_start, old_count, new_start, new_count, ctx


def transform_path_display(path: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    if opts.relative_paths:
        try:
            path = os.path.relpath(path)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if opts.file_transformation:
        m = re.match(r"s(.)(.*?)\1(.*?)\1([g]*)$", opts.file_transformation)
        if m:
            _, pat, repl, flags = m.groups()
            try:
                path = re.sub(pat, repl, path, 0 if "g" in flags else 1)
            except re.error:
                pass
    return path


def file_display_name(fs: FileState, opts: Options) -> str:
    oldp = transform_path_display(clean_path(fs.rename_from or fs.old_path), opts)
    newp = transform_path_display(clean_path(fs.rename_to or fs.new_path), opts)
    arrow = opts.right_arrow
    if opts.navigate:
        prefix = "Δ "
    else:
        prefix = ""
    if fs.added or oldp == "/dev/null" or oldp == "dev/null":
        return prefix + f"{opts.file_added_label} {newp}".strip()
    if fs.deleted or newp == "/dev/null" or newp == "dev/null":
        return prefix + f"{opts.file_removed_label} {oldp}".strip()
    if fs.renamed:
        return prefix + f"{opts.file_renamed_label} {oldp} {arrow} {newp}".strip()
    if fs.copied:
        return prefix + f"{opts.file_copied_label} {oldp} {arrow} {newp}".strip()
    if oldp and newp and oldp != newp:
        label = (opts.file_modified_label + " ") if opts.file_modified_label else ""
        return prefix + f"{label}{oldp} {arrow} {newp}"
    return prefix + (newp or oldp)


def render_file_header(fs: FileState, opts: Options, out: List[str]) -> None:
    if fs.emitted:
        return
    fs.lang = lang_from_path(fs.new_path or fs.old_path, opts.default_language)
    fs.emitted = True
    if fs.file_style if False else False:
        pass
    if opts.file_style.strip().strip('"') == "omit":
        return
    name = file_display_name(fs, opts)
    styled = simple_style(name, opts.file_style, BLUE) or ""
    out.append("\n")
    out.append(styled + "\n")
    if opts.file_decoration_style.strip().strip('"') != "omit":
        deco_style = opts.file_decoration_style
        # Delta's default decoration is blue; most custom decoration colors are approximated.
        deco_code = BLUE
        if "yellow" in deco_style:
            deco_code = YELLOW
        elif "magenta" in deco_style or "purple" in deco_style:
            deco_code = MAGENTA
        elif "red" in deco_style:
            deco_code = RED
        out.append(deco_code + ("─" * max(0, opts.width)) + RESET + "\n")
    out.append("\n")


def hunk_header_text(h: Hunk, fs: FileState, opts: Options) -> str:
    st = opts.hunk_header_style.strip().strip('"')
    if st == "raw":
        return strip_ansi(h.raw_header).rstrip("\n") + " "
    ctx = h.context
    return f"{h.new_start}:{ctx + ' ' if ctx else ' '}"


def render_hunk_header(h: Hunk, fs: FileState, opts: Options, out: List[str]) -> None:
    if opts.hunk_header_style.strip().strip('"') == "omit":
        return
    text = hunk_header_text(h, fs, opts)
    deco_omit = opts.hunk_header_decoration_style.strip().strip('"') == "omit"
    deco_color = BLUE
    if "magenta" in opts.hunk_header_decoration_style or "purple" in opts.hunk_header_decoration_style:
        deco_color = MAGENTA
    if opts.diff_so_fancy:
        deco_color = MAGENTA
    if opts.hunk_header_style.strip().strip('"') == "raw":
        styled_mid = text
    else:
        # Color just the line number blue, syntax-highlight trailing context.
        prefix = f"{BLUE}{h.new_start}{RESET}:"
        body = text.split(":", 1)[1]
        styled_mid = prefix + syntax_highlight(body, fs.lang, opts) if body.strip() else prefix + body
    if deco_omit:
        out.append(styled_mid + "\n")
        return
    w = visible_len(text)
    out.append(deco_color + ("─" * w) + RESET + deco_color + "┐" + RESET + "\n")
    out.append(styled_mid + " " * max(0, w - visible_len(styled_mid)) + deco_color + "│" + RESET + "\n")
    out.append(deco_color + ("─" * w) + RESET + deco_color + "┘" + RESET + "\n")


def expand_tabs(s: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    try:
        return s.expandtabs(max(0, opts.tabs))
    except Exception:
        return s


def similar(a: str, b: str) -> float:
    if not a and not b:
        return 1.0
    return difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b).ratio()


def diff_emphasis_intervals(old: str, new: str) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[int, int]], List[Tuple[int, int]]]:
    sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, old, new)
    old_int: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
    new_int: List[Tuple[int, int]] = []
    for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
        if tag == "equal":
            continue
        if i2 > i1:
            old_int.append((i1, i2))
        if j2 > j1:
            new_int.append((j1, j2))
    return old_int, new_int


def style_context(content: str, fs: FileState, opts: Options, keep_marker: bool = False) -> str:
    content = expand_tabs(content, opts)
    if opts.zero_style.strip().strip('"') == "raw":
        return (" " if keep_marker else "") + content
    if content == "" and not keep_marker:
        return ""
    if keep_marker:
        return " " + (syntax_highlight(content, fs.lang, opts) if content else "")
    return syntax_highlight(content, fs.lang, opts)


def style_minus(content: str, fs: FileState, opts: Options, keep_marker: bool = False,
                side: bool = False, emph: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ()) -> str:
    content = expand_tabs(content, opts)
    cols = colors_for(opts)
    bg = cols["minus_bg"]
    if opts.minus_style.strip().strip('"') == "raw":
        return ("-" if keep_marker else "") + content
    body = ("-" + content) if keep_marker else content
    if side:
        # Side-by-side uses foreground syntax color on removed text.
        styled = syntax_highlight(body, fs.lang if not keep_marker else "txt", opts, cols["minus_bg_code"], emph)
    else:
        # Normal delta default: removed lines are "normal" on background.
        if emph:
            styled = syntax_highlight(body, "txt", opts, cols["minus_bg_code"], emph)
        else:
            styled = bg + body + RESET
    return styled


def style_plus(content: str, fs: FileState, opts: Options, keep_marker: bool = False,
               side: bool = False, emph: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ()) -> str:
    content = expand_tabs(content, opts)
    cols = colors_for(opts)
    if opts.plus_style.strip().strip('"') == "raw":
        return ("+" if keep_marker else "") + content
    if keep_marker:
        # Marker has the added-line background; content is syntax-highlighted with the bg retained.
        return cols["plus_bg"] + "+" + syntax_highlight(content, fs.lang, opts, None, emph)
    return syntax_highlight(content, fs.lang, opts, cols["plus_bg_code"], emph)


def append_fill_for_kind(styled: str, kind: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    cols = colors_for(opts)
    if kind == "minus" and opts.minus_style.strip().strip('"') != "raw":
        return styled + cols["minus_bg"] + ERASE_EOL + RESET
    if kind == "plus" and opts.plus_style.strip().strip('"') != "raw":
        return styled + cols["plus_bg"] + ERASE_EOL + RESET
    return styled


def num_field(n: Optional[int], kind: str, side: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    blank = n is None
    text = "    " if blank else f"{n:>3} "
    if kind == "zero":
        code = colors_for(opts)["zero_num"]
    elif kind == "minus":
        code = "\x1b[38;5;88m"
    elif kind == "plus":
        code = "\x1b[38;5;28m"
    else:
        code = colors_for(opts)["zero_num"]
    return code + text


def line_number_prefix(oldn: Optional[int], newn: Optional[int], kind: str, opts: Options,
                       reset_before_content: bool = False) -> str:
    left_kind = "minus" if kind in ("minus", "plus") else "zero"
    right_kind = "plus" if kind in ("minus", "plus") else "zero"
    s = BLUE + num_field(oldn, left_kind, "left", opts) + BLUE + "⋮" + num_field(newn, right_kind, "right", opts) + BLUE + "│"
    if reset_before_content:
        s += RESET
    return s


def render_hunk_lines_normal(h: Hunk, fs: FileState, opts: Options, out: List[str]) -> None:
    oldn = h.old_start
    newn = h.new_start
    i = 0
    lines = h.lines
    while i < len(lines):
        line = strip_ansi(lines[i]).rstrip("\n")
        if line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
            # Collect a minus/plus run for emphasis pairing.
            minus_group: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
            plus_group: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
            while i < len(lines):
                s = strip_ansi(lines[i]).rstrip("\n")
                if s.startswith("-") and not s.startswith("---"):
                    minus_group.append((oldn, s[1:]))
                    oldn += 1; i += 1
                else:
                    break
            while i < len(lines):
                s = strip_ansi(lines[i]).rstrip("\n")
                if s.startswith("+") and not s.startswith("+++"):
                    plus_group.append((newn, s[1:]))
                    newn += 1; i += 1
                else:
                    break
            pair_emph_minus: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]] = {}
            pair_emph_plus: Dict[int, List[Tuple[int, int]]] = {}
            if len(minus_group) == 1 and len(plus_group) == 1 and similar(minus_group[0][1], plus_group[0][1]) >= opts.max_line_distance:
                mi, pi = diff_emphasis_intervals(minus_group[0][1], plus_group[0][1])
                pair_emph_minus[0] = mi; pair_emph_plus[0] = pi
            for idx, (n, content) in enumerate(minus_group):
                styled = style_minus(content, fs, opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers, False, pair_emph_minus.get(idx, []))
                styled = append_fill_for_kind(styled, "minus", opts)
                if opts.line_numbers:
                    styled = line_number_prefix(n, None, "minus", opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers) + styled
                out.append(styled + "\n")
            for idx, (n, content) in enumerate(plus_group):
                styled = style_plus(content, fs, opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers, False, pair_emph_plus.get(idx, []))
                styled = append_fill_for_kind(styled, "plus", opts)
                if opts.line_numbers:
                    styled = line_number_prefix(None, n, "plus", opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers) + styled
                out.append(styled + "\n")
            continue
        if line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
            content = line[1:]
            styled = style_plus(content, fs, opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers)
            styled = append_fill_for_kind(styled, "plus", opts)
            if opts.line_numbers:
                styled = line_number_prefix(None, newn, "plus", opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers) + styled
            newn += 1; i += 1
            out.append(styled + "\n")
            continue
        if line.startswith(" ") or line == "":
            content = line[1:] if line.startswith(" ") else line
            styled = style_context(content, fs, opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers)
            if opts.line_numbers:
                styled = line_number_prefix(oldn, newn, "zero", opts, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers) + styled
            oldn += 1; newn += 1; i += 1
            out.append(styled + "\n")
            continue
        if line.startswith("\\ No newline at end of file"):
            out.append(line + "\n")
            i += 1
            continue
        # Unknown hunk content: pass through.
        out.append(line + "\n")
        i += 1


def side_content(content: str, kind: str, fs: FileState, opts: Options, colw: int,
                 keep_marker: bool = False, emph: Sequence[Tuple[int, int]] = ()) -> str:
    raw_content = content
    if keep_marker:
        if kind == "zero":
            raw_content = " " + content
        elif kind == "minus":
            raw_content = "-" + content
        elif kind == "plus":
            raw_content = "+" + content
    vis = len(expand_tabs(raw_content, opts))
    pad = max(0, colw - vis)
    cols = colors_for(opts)
    if kind == "blank":
        return " " * colw
    if kind == "zero":
        styled = style_context(content, fs, opts, keep_marker)
        return styled + " " * pad
    if kind == "minus":
        styled = style_minus(content, fs, opts, keep_marker, True, emph)
        if opts.minus_style.strip().strip('"') != "raw":
            return styled + cols["minus_bg"] + " " * pad + RESET
        return styled + " " * pad
    if kind == "plus":
        styled = style_plus(content, fs, opts, keep_marker, True, emph)
        if opts.plus_style.strip().strip('"') != "raw":
            return styled + cols["plus_bg"] + " " * pad + RESET
        return styled + " " * pad
    return raw_content + " " * pad


def side_prefix(n: Optional[int], kind: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    nk = "zero" if kind == "zero" else kind if kind in ("minus", "plus") else "zero"
    return BLUE + "│" + num_field(n, nk, "side", opts) + BLUE + "│"


def render_side_row(left: Tuple[Optional[int], str, str, Sequence[Tuple[int, int]]],
                    right: Tuple[Optional[int], str, str, Sequence[Tuple[int, int]]],
                    fs: FileState, opts: Options, out: List[str]) -> None:
    colw = max(1, opts.width // 2 - 6)
    ln, lkind, lcontent, lemph = left
    rn, rkind, rcontent, remph = right
    s = side_prefix(ln, lkind if lkind != "blank" else "zero", opts)
    s += side_content(lcontent, lkind, fs, opts, colw, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers, lemph)
    s += side_prefix(rn, rkind if rkind != "blank" else "zero", opts)
    s += side_content(rcontent, rkind, fs, opts, colw, opts.keep_plus_minus_markers, remph).rstrip()
    out.append(s + "\n")


def render_hunk_lines_side_by_side(h: Hunk, fs: FileState, opts: Options, out: List[str]) -> None:
    oldn = h.old_start
    newn = h.new_start
    i = 0
    lines = h.lines
    while i < len(lines):
        s = strip_ansi(lines[i]).rstrip("\n")
        if s.startswith(" ") or s == "":
            content = s[1:] if s.startswith(" ") else s
            render_side_row((oldn, "zero", content, ()), (newn, "zero", content, ()), fs, opts, out)
            oldn += 1; newn += 1; i += 1
            continue
        if s.startswith("-") and not s.startswith("---"):
            minus_group: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
            plus_group: List[Tuple[int, str]] = []
            while i < len(lines):
                t = strip_ansi(lines[i]).rstrip("\n")
                if t.startswith("-") and not t.startswith("---"):
                    minus_group.append((oldn, t[1:])); oldn += 1; i += 1
                else:
                    break
            while i < len(lines):
                t = strip_ansi(lines[i]).rstrip("\n")
                if t.startswith("+") and not t.startswith("+++"):
                    plus_group.append((newn, t[1:])); newn += 1; i += 1
                else:
                    break
            if len(minus_group) == 1 and len(plus_group) == 1 and similar(minus_group[0][1], plus_group[0][1]) >= opts.max_line_distance:
                mi, pi = diff_emphasis_intervals(minus_group[0][1], plus_group[0][1])
                render_side_row((minus_group[0][0], "minus", minus_group[0][1], mi),
                                (plus_group[0][0], "plus", plus_group[0][1], pi), fs, opts, out)
            else:
                for n, c in minus_group:
                    render_side_row((n, "minus", c, ()), (None, "blank", "", ()), fs, opts, out)
                for n, c in plus_group:
                    render_side_row((None, "blank", "", ()), (n, "plus", c, ()), fs, opts, out)
            continue
        if s.startswith("+") and not s.startswith("+++"):
            render_side_row((None, "blank", "", ()), (newn, "plus", s[1:], ()), fs, opts, out)
            newn += 1; i += 1
            continue
        out.append(s + "\n")
        i += 1


def render_hunk(h: Hunk, fs: FileState, opts: Options, out: List[str]) -> None:
    render_hunk_header(h, fs, opts, out)
    if opts.side_by_side:
        render_hunk_lines_side_by_side(h, fs, opts, out)
    else:
        render_hunk_lines_normal(h, fs, opts, out)


def render_diff_so_fancy(text: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    # A small emulation of the observed preset.
    o2 = dataclasses.replace(opts)
    o2.file_style = "raw"
    out: List[str] = []
    fs = FileState()
    in_hunk = False
    for raw in text.splitlines(True):
        line = strip_ansi(raw).rstrip("\n")
        dg = parse_diff_git(line)
        if dg:
            fs = FileState(old_path=dg[0], new_path=dg[1], lang=lang_from_path(dg[1], opts.default_language))
            name = file_display_name(fs, opts)
            out.append("\n" + BOLD_YELLOW + "━" * max(0, opts.width) + RESET + "\n")
            out.append(BRIGHT_YELLOW_FG + name + RESET + "\n")
            out.append(BOLD_YELLOW + "━" * max(0, opts.width) + RESET + "\n\n")
            continue
        h = parse_hunk_header(line)
        if h:
            old_start, _, new_start, _, ctx = h
            label = f"{clean_path(fs.new_path or fs.old_path)}:{new_start}: "
            w = visible_len(label)
            out.append(MAGENTA + "─" * w + RESET + MAGENTA + "┐" + RESET + "\n")
            out.append(BLUE + clean_path(fs.new_path or fs.old_path) + RESET + ":" + BLUE + str(new_start) + RESET + ": " + MAGENTA + "│" + RESET + "\n")
            out.append(MAGENTA + "─" * w + RESET + MAGENTA + "┘" + RESET + "\n")
            in_hunk = True
            continue
        if line.startswith(("index ", "--- ", "+++ ", "new file", "deleted file", "similarity ", "rename ")):
            continue
        if in_hunk and line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
            out.append(BOLD_RED + line[1:] + RESET + "\n")
        elif in_hunk and line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"): 
            out.append(BOLD_GREEN + line[1:] + RESET + "\n")
        elif in_hunk and line.startswith(" "):
            out.append(line[1:] + "\n")
        else:
            out.append(line + ("\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""))
    return "".join(out)


def render_diff_highlight(text: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    out: List[str] = []
    in_hunk = False
    for raw in text.splitlines(True):
        line = strip_ansi(raw).rstrip("\n")
        if parse_hunk_header(line):
            in_hunk = True
            out.append(line + "\n")
        elif in_hunk and line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
            out.append(RED + line[1:] + RESET + "\n")
        elif in_hunk and line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
            out.append(GREEN + line[1:] + RESET + "\n")
        elif in_hunk and line.startswith(" "):
            out.append(line[1:] + "\n")
        else:
            out.append(line + ("\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""))
    return "".join(out)


def render_structured_diff(text: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    if opts.diff_so_fancy:
        return render_diff_so_fancy(text, opts)
    if opts.diff_highlight:
        return render_diff_highlight(text, opts)

    out: List[str] = []
    fs: Optional[FileState] = None
    pending_hunk: Optional[Hunk] = None
    in_hunk = False
    saw_diff = False

    def flush_hunk() -> None:
        nonlocal pending_hunk
        if pending_hunk is not None and fs is not None:
            render_file_header(fs, opts, out)
            render_hunk(pending_hunk, fs, opts, out)
        pending_hunk = None

    lines = text.splitlines(True)
    for raw in lines:
        # Preserve no-newline? Most test inputs end in newline; normalize like delta does.
        line = strip_ansi(raw).rstrip("\n")
        dg = parse_diff_git(line)
        if dg:
            flush_hunk()
            fs = FileState(old_path=dg[0], new_path=dg[1])
            fs.lang = lang_from_path(fs.new_path, opts.default_language)
            in_hunk = False
            saw_diff = True
            continue
        # Unified diff header without diff --git.
        if line.startswith("--- ") and not in_hunk:
            flush_hunk()
            if fs is None or fs.emitted:
                fs = FileState()
            fs.old_path = clean_path(line[4:])
            saw_diff = True
            continue
        if line.startswith("+++ ") and not in_hunk and fs is not None:
            fs.new_path = clean_path(line[4:])
            fs.added = fs.old_path in ("/dev/null", "dev/null")
            fs.deleted = fs.new_path in ("/dev/null", "dev/null")
            fs.lang = lang_from_path(fs.new_path if not fs.deleted else fs.old_path, opts.default_language)
            continue
        # Metadata lines.
        if fs is not None and not in_hunk:
            if line.startswith("new file mode"):
                fs.added = True; continue
            if line.startswith("deleted file mode"):
                fs.deleted = True; continue
            if line.startswith("similarity index"):
                continue
            if line.startswith("copy from "):
                fs.copied = True; fs.rename_from = clean_path(line[len("copy from "):]); continue
            if line.startswith("copy to "):
                fs.copied = True; fs.rename_to = clean_path(line[len("copy to "):]); continue
            if line.startswith("rename from "):
                fs.renamed = True; fs.rename_from = clean_path(line[len("rename from "):]); continue
            if line.startswith("rename to "):
                fs.renamed = True; fs.rename_to = clean_path(line[len("rename to "):]); continue
            if line.startswith(("index ", "old mode ", "new mode ", "dissimilarity index")):
                continue
            if line.startswith("Binary files ") or line.startswith("GIT binary patch"):
                render_file_header(fs, opts, out)
                out.append(line + "\n")
                continue
        hp = parse_hunk_header(line)
        if hp:
            flush_hunk()
            if fs is None:
                fs = FileState(old_path="", new_path="")
            old_start, old_count, new_start, new_count, ctx = hp
            pending_hunk = Hunk(raw_header=line, old_start=old_start, old_count=old_count,
                                new_start=new_start, new_count=new_count, context=ctx, lines=[])
            in_hunk = True
            saw_diff = True
            continue
        if in_hunk and pending_hunk is not None:
            # Hunk body continues while lines have diff markers or no-newline marker.
            if (line.startswith((" ", "+", "-")) and not line.startswith(("+++ ", "--- "))) or line.startswith("\\ No newline") or line == "":
                pending_hunk.lines.append(line)
                continue
            # Any other line ends the hunk.
            flush_hunk()
            in_hunk = False
        # Preamble / commit metadata.
        try:
            commit_re = re.compile(opts.commit_regex)
        except re.error:
            commit_re = re.compile(r"^commit ")
        if commit_re.search(line):
            st = opts.commit_style.strip().strip('"')
            if st == "omit":
                pass
            elif st == "raw":
                out.append(line + ("\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""))
            else:
                styled = simple_style(line, opts.commit_style, BLUE)
                if styled is not None:
                    out.append(styled + ("\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""))
        else:
            out.append(raw)
    flush_hunk()
    if not saw_diff:
        # Maybe blame; otherwise pass through.
        blame = try_render_blame(text, opts)
        if blame is not None:
            return blame
        return text
    return "".join(out)


# Raw/color-only/parse-ansi -------------------------------------------------


def render_raw(text: str) -> str:
    out: List[str] = []
    for raw in text.splitlines(True):
        line = raw.rstrip("\n")
        plain = strip_ansi(line)
        nl = "\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""
        if "\x1b[" in line:
            out.append(line + nl)
        elif plain.startswith("-") and not plain.startswith("---"):
            out.append(RED + line + RESET + nl)
        elif plain.startswith("+") and not plain.startswith("+++"):
            out.append(GREEN + line + RESET + nl)
        else:
            out.append(line + nl)
    return "".join(out)


def render_color_only(text: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    out: List[str] = []
    fs = FileState(lang=opts.default_language)
    in_hunk = False
    for raw in text.splitlines(True):
        line = strip_ansi(raw).rstrip("\n")
        nl = "\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""
        dg = parse_diff_git(line)
        if dg:
            fs = FileState(old_path=dg[0], new_path=dg[1], lang=lang_from_path(dg[1], opts.default_language))
            out.append(line + nl); in_hunk = False; continue
        if line.startswith("+++ "):
            fs.new_path = clean_path(line[4:]); fs.lang = lang_from_path(fs.new_path, opts.default_language)
            out.append(line + nl); continue
        if parse_hunk_header(line):
            in_hunk = True
            out.append(line + nl); continue
        if in_hunk and line.startswith("-") and not line.startswith("---"):
            styled = style_minus(line[1:], fs, opts, True)
            out.append(append_fill_for_kind(styled, "minus", opts) + nl)
        elif in_hunk and line.startswith("+") and not line.startswith("+++"):
            styled = style_plus(line[1:], fs, opts, True)
            out.append(append_fill_for_kind(styled, "plus", opts) + nl)
        elif in_hunk and line.startswith(" "):
            # Keep the leading space structurally, but color only the content.
            content = line[1:]
            out.append(" " + (syntax_highlight(content, fs.lang, opts) if content else "") + nl)
        else:
            out.append(line + nl)
    return "".join(out)


def parse_ansi_description(params: str) -> str:
    if params in ("", "0"):
        return "normal"
    parts = [int(p) if p.isdigit() else 0 for p in params.split(";") if p != ""]
    names = []
    color_names = {30: "black", 31: "red", 32: "green", 33: "yellow", 34: "blue", 35: "magenta", 36: "cyan", 37: "white"}
    for p in parts:
        if p == 1:
            names.append("bold")
        elif p in color_names:
            names.append(color_names[p])
        elif p == 0:
            names = ["normal"]
    return " ".join(names) if names else "normal"


def render_parse_ansi(text: str) -> str:
    out: List[str] = []
    pos = 0
    style = "normal"
    ansi_pat = re.compile(r"\x1b\[([0-9;]*)m")
    last_escape = ""
    for m in ansi_pat.finditer(text):
        if m.start() > pos:
            seg = text[pos:m.start()]
            out.append(f"({style})" + (last_escape if last_escape else "") + seg)
            last_escape = ""
        style = parse_ansi_description(m.group(1))
        last_escape = m.group(0) if style != "normal" else RESET
        pos = m.end()
    if pos < len(text):
        seg = text[pos:]
        out.append(f"({style})" + (last_escape if style != "normal" else "") + seg)
    return "".join(out)


# Blame ---------------------------------------------------------------------

BLAME_RE = re.compile(r"^([\^0-9a-fA-F]{7,40}) \((.*?)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} [+-]\d{4})\s+(\d+)\) ?(.*)$")


def age_string(dt: _dt.datetime) -> str:
    now = _dt.datetime.now(dt.tzinfo) if dt.tzinfo else _dt.datetime.now()
    days = max(0, (now - dt).days)
    if days >= 365 * 2:
        return f"{days // 365} years ago"
    if days >= 365:
        return "1 year ago"
    if days >= 60:
        return f"{days // 30} months ago"
    if days >= 2:
        return f"{days} days ago"
    if days == 1:
        return "1 day ago"
    return "today"


def try_render_blame(text: str, opts: Options) -> Optional[str]:
    lines = text.splitlines(True)
    if not lines:
        return None
    parsed = []
    for raw in lines:
        m = BLAME_RE.match(raw.rstrip("\n"))
        if not m:
            return None
        commit, author, ts, n, code = m.groups()
        parsed.append((commit, author.rstrip(), ts, int(n), code))
    palette = [(0, 0, 0), (34, 34, 34), (68, 68, 68)]
    out: List[str] = []
    for idx, (commit, author, ts, n, code) in enumerate(parsed):
        try:
            dt = _dt.datetime.strptime(ts, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")
            age = age_string(dt)
        except Exception:
            age = ts[:10]
        r, g, b = palette[idx % len(palette)]
        bg = f"\x1b[48;2;{r};{g};{b}m"
        meta = f"{age:<15} {author:<15.14} {commit[:8]:<8}"
        sep = f"│{n:^4}│"
        out.append(bg + meta + RESET + bg + "│" + RESET + bg + f"{n:^4}" + RESET + bg + "│" + RESET)
        out.append(f"\x1b[48;2;{r};{g};{b};38;5;231m {code}" + RESET + bg + ERASE_EOL + RESET + "\n")
    return "".join(out)


# Informational commands ----------------------------------------------------


def output_help(long: bool) -> None:
    name = "help_long.txt" if long else "help_short.txt"
    txt = read_data(name)
    if txt is None:
        # Fallback from bundled manual.
        md = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "manual" / "src" / "full---help-output.md"
        if md.exists():
            s = md.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            if "```txt\n" in s:
                start = s.index("```txt\n") + len("```txt\n")
                end = s.index("\n```", start)
                txt = s[start:end] + "\n"
        if txt is None:
            txt = "A viewer for git and diff output\n\nUsage: delta [OPTIONS] [MINUS_FILE] [PLUS_FILE]\n"
    sys.stdout.write(txt)


def show_config(opts: Options) -> str:
    # If no config-affecting options are supplied, use the captured exact default.
    default = read_data("show_config_default.txt")
    if default and opts == Options(show_config=True):
        return default
    cols = colors_for(opts)
    true_color = "true" if opts.true_color == "always" else "false"
    lines = [
        ("commit-style", opts.commit_style),
        ("file-style", simple_style(opts.file_style, opts.file_style, BLUE) or opts.file_style),
        ("hunk-header-style", opts.hunk_header_style),
        ("minus-style", cols["minus_bg"] + "normal 52" + RESET if not opts.light else cols["minus_bg"] + "normal 224" + RESET),
        ("minus-non-emph-style", cols["minus_bg"] + "normal 52" + RESET if not opts.light else cols["minus_bg"] + "normal 224" + RESET),
        ("minus-emph-style", cols["minus_emph_bg"] + "normal 124" + RESET),
        ("minus-empty-line-marker-style", cols["minus_bg"] + "normal 52" + RESET if not opts.light else cols["minus_bg"] + "normal 224" + RESET),
        ("zero-style", "syntax" if opts.zero_style.startswith("syntax") else opts.zero_style),
        ("plus-style", cols["plus_bg"] + "syntax 22" + RESET if not opts.light else cols["plus_bg"] + "syntax 194" + RESET),
        ("plus-non-emph-style", cols["plus_bg"] + "syntax 22" + RESET if not opts.light else cols["plus_bg"] + "syntax 194" + RESET),
        ("plus-emph-style", cols["plus_emph_bg"] + "syntax 28" + RESET),
        ("plus-empty-line-marker-style", cols["plus_bg"] + "normal 22" + RESET if not opts.light else cols["plus_bg"] + "normal 194" + RESET),
        ("grep-file-style", MAGENTA + "purple" + RESET),
        ("grep-line-number-style", GREEN + "green" + RESET),
        ("whitespace-error-style", REVERSE_PURPLE + "reverse purple" + RESET),
        ("blame-palette", "\x1b[48;5;16m#000000\x1b[0m \x1b[48;5;235m#222222\x1b[0m \x1b[48;5;238m#444444\x1b[0m"),
        ("true-color", true_color),

        ("file-modified-label", repr(opts.file_modified_label)),
        ("file-removed-label", repr(opts.file_removed_label)),
        ("file-renamed-label", repr(opts.file_renamed_label)),

        ("paging", opts.paging),

        ("syntax-theme", opts.syntax_theme),
        ("width", str(opts.width)),
        ("tabs", str(opts.tabs)),

    ]
    return "".join(f"    {k:<31} = {v}\n" for k, v in lines)


def handle_info_command(opts: Options) -> bool:
    if opts.help_long or opts.help_short:
        output_help(opts.help_long)
        return True
    if opts.version:
        sys.stdout.write("delta 0.18.2\n")
        return True
    if opts.generate_completion:
        txt = read_data("completion_" + opts.generate_completion)
        if txt is None:
            bundled = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "etc" / "completion" / f"completion.{opts.generate_completion}"
            txt = bundled.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if bundled.exists() else ""
        sys.stdout.write(txt)
        return True
    if opts.list_syntax_themes:
        sys.stdout.write(read_data("list_syntax_themes.txt") or "Monokai Extended\n")
        return True
    if opts.list_languages:
        sys.stdout.write(read_data("list_languages.txt") or "Python                    \x1b[32mpy\x1b[0m\n")
        return True
    if opts.show_colors:
        sys.stdout.write(read_data("show_colors.txt") or "")
        return True
    if opts.show_syntax_themes:
        sys.stdout.write(read_data("show_syntax_themes.txt") or "")
        return True
    if opts.show_themes:
        err = read_data("show_themes.err") or "No themes found. Please see https://dandavison.github.io/delta/custom-themes.html.\n"
        sys.stderr.write(err)
        raise SystemExit(2)
    if opts.show_config:
        sys.stdout.write(show_config(opts))
        return True
    return False


# File diff -----------------------------------------------------------------


def run_file_diff(files: Sequence[str], opts: Options) -> Tuple[str, int]:
    color_arg = "--color=always" if opts.raw else "--color=never"
    cmd = ["git", "diff", "--no-index", color_arg]
    if opts.diff_args:
        try:
            cmd += shlex.split(opts.diff_args)
        except ValueError:
            cmd += opts.diff_args.split()
    cmd += [files[0], files[1]]
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)
        out = p.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        if p.stderr:
            # git diff --no-index writes useful errors to stderr; delta passes them through.
            sys.stderr.write(p.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
        return out, p.returncode
    except Exception:
        # Fallback using difflib if git is unavailable.
        try:
            a = Path(files[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines(True)
            b = Path(files[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines(True)
        except OSError as e:
            sys.stderr.write(str(e) + "\n")
            return "", 2
        diff = difflib.unified_diff(a, b, fromfile="a/" + clean_path(files[0]), tofile="b/" + clean_path(files[1]))
        body = "".join(diff)
        header = f"diff --git a/{clean_path(files[0])} b/{clean_path(files[1])}\n"
        return header + body, 1 if body else 0


# Main ----------------------------------------------------------------------


def render_input(text: str, opts: Options) -> str:
    if opts.parse_ansi:
        return render_parse_ansi(text)
    if opts.raw:
        return render_raw(text)
    if opts.color_only:
        return render_color_only(text, opts)
    return render_structured_diff(text, opts)


def main(argv: Sequence[str]) -> int:
    opts = load_configured_options(argv)
    if handle_info_command(opts):
        return 0
    exit_code = 0
    if len(opts.files) >= 2:
        text, exit_code = run_file_diff(opts.files[:2], opts)
    else:
        if sys.stdin is None or sys.stdin.closed or sys.stdin.isatty():
            text = ""
        else:
            data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
            text = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    out = render_input(text, opts)
    try:
        sys.stdout.write(out)
    except BrokenPipeError:
        return 0
    return exit_code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        raise SystemExit(130)
